name: mordred-burnished-avenger-banished-off-element-attack-click-refused
notes: Mordred, Burnished Avenger (OWCdWq3mXY): "If you do, you may activate that card this turn." Real play: level up banishes the top-of-deck FIRE Emberslash (tagged _mordredBurnished, step 4); player 1's champion enables only WATER, so the activation is illegal (elemental requirement). The click at step 5 is accepted as a no-op, so the refusal is asserted on state: the card stays in banishment with its tag, hand/memory/effect stack unchanged. Before the fix the card was moved into hand (hand 9, banish count 1) with no activation.

rulesClauses: If you do, you may activate that card this turn.
A card whose element requirement is not met cannot be activated.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The ActionMap 'myBanish' (and 'theirBanish') branches that let a player activate a tagged banished card moved it into hand and tore down its permission BEFORE confirming that the activation could begin. When the activation was then refused (first-turn attack lock, element requirement, link/prereq gate) or could not be paid for, the card was stranded in hand or on the effect stack, its permission tag was lost, and pre-activation side effects (Seething Intercession / Desperate Cavalier 2 unpreventable damage, Shattering Discharge charge counter, Limitless Defiance champion wake-up) had already happened. Fix: new shared ActivateBanishedCard() validates first through the same gates DoActivateCard uses (new ActivationBlockedBeforeAnnounce(), now also called by DoActivateCard) plus CanActivateCard prereqs and CanAffordCardActivation, and only then moves/activates; a refused click changes no state.
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php ActionMap() case 'myBanish'/'theirBanish' move-to-hand-then-ActivateCard branches; DoActivateCard() pre-announce gates; new ActivationBlockedBeforeAnnounce(), ActivateBanishedCard()
engineBug.verification: Per-step state dump: before the fix the step-5 click moves 0xylS3OcNa from banish-1 into hand (hand 8 -> 9); after the fix banish/hand are identical to step 4. Break/restore recorded in the fix commit message.
